traditional_use: Used to store or serve dry foods and household or personal items.
story_so: Dambiil waa shayga labaad ee ku qoran diiwaanka madxafka. Diiwaanku wuxuu ku tilmaamayaa dambiil gacmeed la tolay oo aan qoto dheerayn, leh sal kor u taagan iyo dabool weyn oo qaab koon ah. Waxaa laga sameeyey fiilooyin dhir la tolay. Waxaa loo isticmaali jiray kaydinta ama bixinta cuntooyinka qalalan iyo alaabta guriga ama agabka shakhsiga ah.
story_en: Dambiil is identified as artifact 2 in the supplied inventory. It is described as a shallow woven basket with a pedestal base and a large fitted conical lid. The inventory identifies woven plant fibers as its material. Traditionally, it was used to store or serve dry foods and household or personal items.

passages.text: The inventory describes Dambiil as a shallow woven basket with a pedestal base and a large fitted conical lid.
The inventory lists woven plant fibers as the material used for Dambiil.
Dambiil was used to store or serve dry foods and household or personal items.
Diiwaanku wuxuu Dambiil ku tilmaamayaa dambiil aan qoto dheerayn oo leh sal kor u taagan iyo dabool weyn oo qaab koon ah.
Diiwaanku wuxuu sheegayaa in Dambiil laga sameeyey fiilooyin dhir la tolay.
Dambiil waxaa loo isticmaali jiray kaydinta ama bixinta cuntooyinka qalalan iyo alaabta guriga ama agabka shakhsiga ah.
